children: GCC, S.A.B. de C.V. (BMV: GCC*; the “Company”),

a leading producer of cement and concrete in the United States and Mexico, announced today that, following the favorable arbitral award obtained on November 5, 2025, the Company entered into a settlement agreement and received a gross payment of US$71.5 million. The arbitration proceeding arose in connection with GCC’s sale, in 2011, of its equity interest in SOBOCE, S.A. to Consorcio Cementero del Sur, S.A.
As a result of the execution of the settlement agreement and receipt of the payment, the dispute has been fully and finally resolved, with no further liability for GCC in connection therewith.
This material event is disclosed in accordance with Article 50 of the Circular Única de Emisoras.

GCC is a leading supplier and producer of cement, concrete, aggregates, and construction‐related services in the United States, Mexico and Canada, with an annual cement production capacity of 6 million metric tons. Founded in 1941, the Company’s shares are listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol GCC*.
